_comment: Armband colours (#447): everyone wears a coloured band on both upper arms so you can tell who is who in a fight. players: co-op players (you and your friends); civilians; enemies: soldiers with no faction, and any faction not listed under factions; factions: a colour per soldier faction id (modules/factions/data/factions.json). Colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1. glow: how much the band lights itself so it still reads at night (0 none; past about 1 it starts to bloom like a lamp). colour_blind: the same table, used instead when a player turns on 'Colour-blind colours' in Settings. Against the dark uniforms only light colours stand out, and red-green colour blind eyes see just blue against yellow plus lightness, and sunlight lifts every band towards white, so pale blue and white are the one pair that stays close; it is spent on two friends. players sky blue (the partner marker's blue), civilians off-white, regulars amber (bright yellow to red-green colour blind eyes), militia deep blue (much darker and stronger than the players' sky blue), scavengers deep red (dark olive to red-green colour blind eyes, the weakest against its uniform).
